In [[algebraic geometry]], a '''symmetric variety''' is an algebraic analogue of a [[symmetric space]] in [[differential geometry]], given by a quotient ''G''/''H'' of a [[reductive algebraic group]] ''G'' by the [[fixed-point subgroup|subgroup ''H'' fixed]] by some [[involution (mathematics)|involution]] of ''G''.
